headline: 仙逆剧场版领跑，Kill Jackie首播
summary: 本周电影由《仙逆剧场版：弑仙之战》《挖掘者》等热作领跑；剧集端《Kill Jackie》《女巫团学院》首播，热播《侠探杰克》《母狮》《末日地堡》持续吸睛，待映有《复仇者联盟5》《沙丘3》。

industryHighlights.text: 电影热作：《仙逆剧场版：弑仙之战》《挖掘者》等领跑本周片单。
industryHighlights.en: Movie heat: Xian Ni Movie: Battle of Immortals and The Digger lead this week's film slate.

industryHighlights.text: 新剧首播：《Kill Jackie》《女巫团学院》《装备我最强》本周开播。
industryHighlights.en: New premieres: Kill Jackie, Witch Academy and Gear Up debut this week.

industryHighlights.text: 热播剧集：《侠探杰克》《母狮》《末日地堡》及多部异世界动画持续在播。
industryHighlights.en: On-air: Reacher, Lioness, Silo and multiple isekai anime continue.

industryHighlights.text: 待映电影：《复仇者联盟5》《沙丘3》《泥面人》等列入期待片单。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming: Avengers 5, Dune 3, Clayface and more are on the anticipation slate.

headlineEn: Xian Ni Movie Leads, Kill Jackie Premieres
summaryEn: This week's film slate is led by Xian Ni Movie: Battle of Immortals and The Digger; on TV, Kill Jackie and Witch Academy premiere, while Reacher, Lioness and Silo stay hot, with Avengers 5 and Dune 3 upcoming.
